detail.longDescription: @ shollyethan The last two years have been a transition in which GenAI destroyed so much of the software world. Less and less human soul woven into projects. Human creativity and imagination is what once was thriving projects. Now it's just "I want to get big for fame and money". I'm glad I built my own nostalgic ecosystem as an anti-ai maintainer. My little, modern corner of a time past. Still, it's depressing, really. # FOSS # OpenSource # SelfHosted
